data.name: The Cape, A Thompson Hotel, by Hyatt
data.address: Carr. Transpeninsular km. 5, Tourist Corridor, Misiones, 23455 Cabo San Lucas, B.C.S., Mexico
data.description:
Set in a secluded area along the Pacific Ocean, this ritzy hotel is 40 km from Los Cabos International Airport and 11 km from El Arco de Cabo San Lucas, a rock formation.
Polished rooms with custom furnishings, and balconies with ocean and rock views offer free Wi-Fi and flat-screen TVs, as well as cocktail bars and minibars. They also feature rainfall showers and free-standing tubs. Suites add sitting areas or living rooms; upgraded suites have plunge pools. Villas include kitchens and complimentary breakfast.
There are 2 modern restaurants and 4 bars (1 rooftop), plus a private beach with a snack bar. There's also an infinity pool and a spa.
